description: Spreadsheet builder. Use when a task has to hand back a real spreadsheet rather than a wall of rows: typed columns (text, number, date, currency, percent) with number formats applied, a bold header, optional frozen header row, column widths and an autofilter, returned as a base64 .xlsx or .csv. Up to 10 sheets and 50,000 cells in total (the header row counts). Values that could be read back as formulas are neutralised. Dates go in as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS; percent cells store a fraction (0.15 is 15%) unless the column sets percent_basis to "percent". CSV takes one sheet. Cost: 1 credit per call.

format.description: xlsx (default) or csv. CSV takes one sheet.

sheets.description: Up to 10 sheets. Each has a name, a columns list and an optional rows list, plus freeze_header and autofilter flags.

autofilter.description: Add an autofilter to the header row.

columns.description: Each column: key, label and type (text, number, date, currency, percent), with optional width and percent_basis.

name.description: The sheet name, up to 31 characters and unique in the workbook.

rows.description: Each row is an object keyed by column key. Up to 50,000 cells in total, header row included.

name: sheets_build
